system.cpu: 11th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-11850H @ 2.50GHz (8 cores, 16 threads)

method: hyperfine -N, 3 warmups, 30 runs; wall time is mean ± σ. Startup and loopback fetch were measured against a 0.0.7 release build from the v0.0.7 tag in the same session, once with each version listed first, because the order has moved results by more than the difference being measured. The 0.0.8 build measured was made from main before the version number was set; binarySize is the release build's. Peak RSS is the largest PeakWorkingSetSize of 5 runs. Rows with lastMeasured were not re-run for 0.0.8. A re-run of startup and fetch on 2026-11-11, after the hardening changes, was within noise in both orders and is in README.md.

benchmarks.name: Startup and greeting
benchmarks.reproduce: hyperfine -N --warmup 3 --runs 30 '<0.0.7 binary> run examples/hello.ts' 'target/release/vaern run examples/hello.ts', then again with the two binaries in the other order; add 'run --no-journal' for the second row
benchmarks.status: Loss vs 0.0.7 with the journal, +1.2 ms with 0.0.7 listed first; +0.3 ms, within noise, the other way round. Not profiled. Within noise with --no-journal. Win vs Node process start

benchmarks.name: Loopback fetch and JSON parse
benchmarks.reproduce: hyperfine -N --warmup 3 --runs 30 '<0.0.7 binary> run examples/fetch-json.ts' 'target/release/vaern run examples/fetch-json.ts', then again in the other order
benchmarks.status: Within noise of 0.0.7 in both orders

benchmarks.name: MCP connect, one call, close
benchmarks.reproduce: hyperfine -N --warmup 3 --runs 30 'target/release/vaern run examples/hello.ts' 'target/release/vaern run bench/mcp-connect.ts' 'target/release/vaern run --no-journal bench/mcp-connect.ts'
benchmarks.status: New in 0.0.8, not a regression: starting a server script as a second vaern process, one tool call and a close add 26.3 ms to a run with the journal (18.8 ms with --no-journal on caller and server)

benchmarks.name: Arithmetic loop (1M)
benchmarks.status: +7.5 ms vs 0.0.6, within σ; about the journal's startup cost. Win vs Node; Node startup dominates at this size
benchmarks.lastMeasured: Not re-run for 0.0.8; no change touched this path. Values are 0.0.7 against 0.0.6, measured 2026-11-09.

benchmarks.name: Arithmetic loop (50M)

benchmarks.lastMeasured: Not re-run for 0.0.8; no change touched this path. Values are 0.0.7 against 0.0.6, measured 2026-11-09.
